Skyfire delivers an Agentic Commerce Platform, enabling AI to autonomously process payments, verify identities, and access services. It provides crucial financial infrastructure through autonomous payments and Know Your Agent (KYA) identity verification. This allows AI agents to operate and transact independently within the real economy, fostering new digital commerce.

The company was founded by CEO Amir Sarhangi, alongside Craig DeWitt (Product) and Ankit Agarwal (Engineering). This team of experienced engineers and fintech veterans recognized a critical need for AI financial infrastructure. Their collective experience led to Skyfire, a platform enabling AI agents to conduct secure, global, and instant transactions independent of traditional systems.

Skyfire serves developers building AI agents and businesses seeking new revenue from the expanding AI market. Its vision is to establish a fully autonomous AI economy. Providing a trusted network for financially empowered, verified agents, the company aims to be the foundational layer for all future AI-driven commercial interactions.
